title: Concept: Cheque clearing session exposed
description: A clearing session or house reference on a cheque item in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The session names the clearing window and house, which tells an attacker how long a fraudulent cheque has before it is returned and which cut-off to aim for.
applicability: Deployments that render a clearing session or house reference on a cheque item into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The session names the clearing window and house, which tells an attacker how long a fraudulent cheque has before it is returned and which cut-off to aim for.
